title: Focus pull request review on EVE context
summary: Repository pull-request review now stays within the client router and prioritizes only open PRs with an unambiguous exact-head Snapshot. Other open PRs remain available through an inline, count-aware disclosure without refetching or leaving the page.
userVisibleChange: Using the Pull requests breadcrumb from a PR detail page now returns instantly to the selected repository tab without reloading the document. The tab opens with an EVE review queue containing only PRs with current Snapshot context, while a clear Show all open pull requests control reveals or hides the remaining PRs inline.

risks.title: Very large repositories may have contextual PRs beyond the loaded GitHub window
risks.mitigation: Loaded counts are labeled explicitly, unreturned PRs remain unclassified, and the existing GitHub link exposes the authoritative full list.

timeline.title: Locked the navigation and context-filter Plan
timeline.summary: Defined SPA navigation, exact-head Snapshot qualification, progressive disclosure, truthful counts, accessibility, and test requirements.

timeline.title: Added client routing and the EVE review queue
timeline.summary: Replaced the raw breadcrumb anchor, partitioned open PRs by exact-head Snapshot context, filtered the recent banner, and added inline reveal/hide behavior.

timeline.title: Verified routing, interaction, and repository suites
timeline.summary: Used router-level tests and Playwright to verify SPA navigation, then ran UI, build, Go, npm package, and pack checks.

timeline.title: Closed standards and spec findings
timeline.summary: Clarified the shared exact-head predicate, made truncated copy truthful, kept the ARIA-controlled region mounted, and added a real router click test.

decisions.title: Use exact-head Snapshot linkage as the EVE review-queue boundary
decisions.rationale: A current Snapshot proves that EVE has product context for the PR while still allowing invalid, incomplete, or blocked evidence to remain visible for review.

decisions.title: Keep all other open PRs one action away
decisions.rationale: Progressive disclosure keeps Dependabot and uncontextualized work from overwhelming the primary queue without hiding repository reality.

decisions.title: Keep the tab count as the authoritative open PR count
decisions.rationale: The tab represents the repository's pull-request surface, while the panel separately and explicitly counts the EVE-context review queue.

decisions.title: Qualify partial GitHub results as loaded
decisions.rationale: When the API is truncated, EVE only classifies records it received and directs reviewers to GitHub for the remainder.

validation.output: All Go packages passed, including cmd/eve with embedded UI assets.
UI suite passed: 16 files, 52 tests, including router interaction, Snapshot-context partitioning, and disclosure copy coverage.
TypeScript validation and production Vite build passed; embedded UI assets were refreshed.
On the live 14-PR repository dataset, the breadcrumb preserved a window marker across navigation to #pull-requests, proving no document reload; the disclosure revealed all 14 non-context PRs inline.
